sections.title: Plant form and flowers
sections.text: A compact Mexican cactus with a flattened, nearly spherical stem about 6–9 cm across, mostly at or below ground level. The plate’s pink flowers and dense white spines match the published descriptions.

sections.title: Habitat and protection
sections.text: Native to a restricted area of Guanajuato and San Luis Potosí, Mexico, in dry habitats. Kew records it as critically endangered; international trade in this cactus is regulated. No food use is documented.
